Un sospechoso obliga a un miembro del Departamento de Policía de Pembroke Pines a perseguirlo con su vehículo a 72 kph. Una disputa doméstica se convierte en un tiroteo. Una parada de tráfico rutinaria se convierte en una persecución automovilística.
Nick y Katrina investigan el pasado demoníaco de una vivienda en Hinsdale, Nueva York. Nick se ve metido en una batalla psicológica entre el bien y el mal.

Katrina y Nick investigan una mansión victoriana en Cleveland. El castillo Franklin fue el hogar del inmigrante rico Hannes Teidermann, este sepultó a su mujer y a uno de sus hijos mientras vivía allí.

Nick y Katrina investigan el asilo abandonado Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum, en el que se ha registrado presencia paranormal y se encuentra ubicado en Virginia Occidental. Pasan una noche de encierro, y lo que ellos captan es aterrador y único.

Zachary Bernhardt, de ocho años, desaparece de su casa de Florida a altas horas de la noche; las sospechas remolinan alrededor de su madre, pero ella niega cualquier implicación y se aleja, luego otro niño desaparece y nuevas teorías emergen.

Una madre desaparece de su granja. Los investigadores de Missouri intentan descifrar una enigmática nota escrita a mano. ¿Había algo que la preocupaba o fue víctima de un acto criminal? Tiempo después, encuentran en el bosque un cráneo misterioso.
Ashley Summers desapareció en 2007, cuando tenía 14 años. El FBI cree que hay un vínculo entre su caso y los de otras dos mujeres jóvenes que desaparecieron en el mismo barrio.
Logan Schiendelman desaparece y las autoridades encuentran su auto abandonado. No hay evidencias de que se haya tratado de un crimen.

Después de que el adolescente transgénero Sage Smith desaparece en Charlottesville, Virginia, la policía identifica a un sospechoso; luego se evidencia que se debe observar de cerca el círculo interno de Smith.
Diversas personas cuentan cómo fue vivir con amigos o familiares sociópatas que, en determinado momento, llegaron a cometer los más atroces crímenes.

Cuando Matt Roth es un niño, su padrastro le lleva a realizar algunos trabajos de manutención. Él cree que solo está allí para ayudar a su padre, pero no se da cuenta de que está entrando en las escenas de brutales asesinatos.
Christina Gaines tiene una cita con Patrick Fowler, un supuesto caballero perfecto. Sin embargo, pronto descubre la verdadera naturaleza de Patrick, y se da cuenta de que ha sido engañada.
Craig Lester Thrift se jacta de salirse con la suya, pero todos piensan que está bromeando. Robyn Barry conoce a Thrift mejor que nadie y comienza a sospechar que no está bromeando.

La asesina en serie mexicana Sara Aldrete formó parte de la secta Los Narcosatánicos. Lleva más de 30 años presa, acusada de homicidio y profanación de cadáveres. Revela cómo conoció al Brujo de Matamoros y cómo aprendió la santería.

Bubble y Nabi intentan quedarse despiertos toda la noche para hacer feliz a Pip, su huésped murciélago, pero, a medida que pasa el tiempo, empiezan a sentirse supercansados.

p.t: Yvonne Orji: Momma, I Made It!
p.d: Interspersed with footage shot in Nigeria, the comic reflects on being a Nigerian American, talking about her haggling addiction and the line between cursing people out and putting curses on them; from the Howard Theatre in Washington, D.C.
After her 29th birthday, Issa Dee reconsiders her relationship with her live-in boyfriend, Lawrence; Issa's best friend, Molly, laments being single; Issa reconnects with an ex at an open-mic night.

Issa attempts to make a decision about Lawrence while sticking to her plan to embrace a bolder side of herself; Molly treats herself to a fancy day and goes on a promising date; Lawrence gets some advice.
Issa and Lawrence try to move past their issues at home; Issa deals with doubts from her colleagues; Lawrence gets a reality check from a headhunter; Molly introduces Jared to her friends.
Issa turns to Daniel for help during Career Day; Molly finds herself in a tough position at work; Lawrence bonds with a surprising confidante.

Issa searches for a way to get her open mic video taken down; Issa reconnects with Daniel; Lawrence faces questions about his future with Issa; Molly invites her "perfect guy" to a coworker's engagement party.
Issa tries to keep things together while hiding her guilt; Lawrence gets serious about his commitment to Issa; Molly embraces a new relationship.
Issa prepares for an important fundraiser; Lawrence considers a career opportunity; Molly encounters an old friend.
Tension between Molly and Issa threatens to resurface during a trip; Lawrence reconnects with his friends.
Issa struggles in the aftermath of her breakup with Lawrence, while facing challenges at a new work assignment; Molly questions her worth at work; Lawrence adjusts to his new living arrangement.

Issa tries to make sense of a cryptic encounter; Lawrence considers crucial decisions; after receiving some harsh truths, Molly plots to join the office "boys club"; Issa and Frieda encounter a problematic vice principal.
A sexually frustrated Issa explores a new outlook on dating; on a girls' night out, Molly meets a promising new guy; Lawrence's new work friends test his commitment.
Issa has her newfound confidence shaken at a day party; Molly has a blast from the past with childhood friend Dro; a trip to the grocery store turns into a wild and crazy night for Lawrence.

Los arqueólogos llevan muchos años develando misterios, pero algunos como la gran pirámide de Giza, las escaleras de la capilla de Loreto, en Santa Fe, o la misteriosa estructura de piedra llamada el Castillo de Coral siguen siendo un enigma.
Muchos misterios alrededor del planeta Tierra aún no han sido explicados. ¿Cómo se formó la Torre del Diablo? ¿Por qué algunas personas han sido alcanzadas por un rayo en múltiples ocasiones?

Testimonios de personas que se encontraron frente a frente con criaturas extrañas, cuya existencia en teoría es imposible. El Mothman, el chupacabra o el gusano de la muerte del desierto de Mongolia son algunos de estos engendros aterradores.

Las prácticas antiguas como la oración, los deportes de sangre, el vudú y el exorcismo se suelen considerar reliquias de las supersticiones del pasado, pero existen pruebas de que tienen un impacto en el mundo físico.

Un manuscrito medieval, lleno de dibujos no identificables y escrito en un lenguaje secreto tan complejo que incluso los mejores descifradores no han podido descifrar, ha obsesionado a todos, desde académicos hasta teóricos de la conspiración.

Cuando el hijo de una leyenda de la aviación desaparece de su cuna, una tormenta mediática se desata. Tras una persecución nacional, el supuesto culpable es llevado ante la justicia, pero nuevos interrogantes surgen sobre la investigación.

The Wells family at 1 Way Diesel Performance overhauls an old friend's 1993 Chevy Suburban; At Wide Open Garage, Dave and Daniel build a 1997 Pontiac Firebird.
Mike and Elvis buy a piece of the Champagne lifestyle on a budget: a Silver Spirit that looks past its best.
Mike and Elvis tackle a classic Toyota Land Cruiser; Mike takes a gamble and imports an original '70s one from Japan, not knowing what state it will arrive in.
The guys retry road-tripping Stubby Bob to a dirt drag track in Arizona.

Freiburger surprises David Chappelle with a road trip in an old project: Dirt Every Day's '76 Off-Road Pacer. Not much works in this lifted 4x4 AMC, but that doesn't stop the guys from ignoring problems, tempting fate and pressing on down the road.
Freiburger and Finnegan pick up a Hemi-powered pickup to cut up and strip down at the dragstrip at MotorTrend's Roadkill Nights powered by Dodge.
Freiburger and Finnegan complete the Mazdarati 2.0 and bring some of "Roadkill's" project cars back to life; they road trip to a multi-car drag-cross showdown.
Thom and Tom race to Georgia to take a lap with NASCAR driver Bill Elliot; they bring home a '40 Ford Tudor sedan and turn it into a vintage Moonshine Runner.
Josh, Klump and Kevin continue to work on the restoration of the vintage '40 Ford Moonshine Runner; Thomas buys a '60 Cadillac from his high school sweetheart.

Freiburger and Dulcich death-proof their questionably assembled '40 Ford Fordor, then hit the road to multiple junkyards to hunt for a new project vehicle; after a lengthy search, they fall in love with a barn-find '60s truck that's too good.

The '73 Chevy step-side muscle truck has a storied history; Freiburger and guest host Dave Chappelle fabricate another chapter in the truck's saga with the addition of a beefy four-link suspension and coilovers to hopefully get it to sit right.

Freiburger and Dulcich add 1,000+ hp to David's Pro Street 1969 Chevy Nova; in an attempt to make a true street/strip car, the guys fully build out this roller before taking it to the track to run some impressive times out of the gate.
Freiburger and Dulcich return the '67 Crusher Camaro to its original styling, then hit the road to Vegas and back for Hot Rod's first-ever Power Tour West.

Freiburger and Dulcich enlist the fabrication skills of Dave Chappelle to start building the Dragoneer; the LS-powered 1970 Jeep Wagoneer needs a lot of work, but it's on its way to becoming a quick street/strip sleeper.

Dulcich and Freiburger enlist Chris Birdsong to finish the engine transplant into the 1974 Dodge D100 known as the Mopar Muscle Truck; after installing the Gen III Hemi, they hit the dyno to see the massive horsepower and torque the truck now makes.
Two orphans (Heather Rattray, Mark Edward Hall) follow a frontier con man (Robert Logan) over the Rockies to their Oregon inheritance.
Yellowbird (Seth Green), a tiny orphaned bird that has never left the nest, suddenly finds himself leading a flock on its migration to Africa.
Doused with paint, a sparrow's colors change dramatically, leading to a case of mistaken identity.
At his grandmother's house, Scott and his friend Emily meet Rufus, a swashbuckling, furry creature who begs them to help restore his fading kingdom.
A science experiment turns a boy's (Matthew Knight) dog into a human (Ryan Belleville).
An old sea captain helps three young friends solve the 30-year-old case of a missing lighthouse keeper.
An American orphan living in England as part of an exchange program researches information about a special garden.
A man (Dolph Lundgren) leads earthquake survivors against a gang of violent convicts bent on ruling the world.
Bloodsucking party girls find their destinies at stake when one falls for the son of a vampire hunter and the other encounters a long-ago love.
Harry Houdini (Guy Pearce) has an affair with a Scottish con artist (Catherine Zeta-Jones) who claims she knows the final words that his mother spoke on her deathbed.
Increasingly estranged from his own daughter, a boozy busboy (Sam Rockwell) gets a shot at redemption when an old friend (Rob Corddry) hires him to coach a varsity girls basketball team.

Paying tribute to the brave, gravity-defying design of the U.S. National Medal of Honor Museum; traveling to Singapore for a look at a leaning tower of gambling, then exploring a New York City office building that lets the sun shine through.

Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama Desert in Chile; at observatory ALMA he works alongside the expert team as they repair some of the world's biggest antennas.

Mike works with the U.S. Army in Germany inside the massive fix facility the MAK, Maintenance Activity Kaiserslautern, as teams repair over one hundred Bradley fighting vehicles, then embeds with troops in a massive two-week-long battle exercise.
The engineering secrets behind a mobile research station in Antarctica, a gravity-defying concert hall on the Canary Islands, and a rotating boat lift in Scotland.

The American Museum of Natural History in NYC gets a cave-like extension; an arts center inspired by migrating birds is built on a lake in China; Boston University gains a fossil-free, Jenga-like tower.

A 1.2-million-square-foot office building balances precariously on a 39-foot wide base in Chicago; a building named Pterodactyl lands on top of a Los Angeles parking garage; the world's longest suspension footbridge.
